provenance.sourceAccess: Installed Kiln author/refine/QA skills and tool definitions, plus the supplied Muse Q1 instrument source; no engine implementation or other finished examples.
provenance.inheritedContext: Fresh curation conversation with a supplied source from a separate Muse authoring journey.
provenance.startingExample: The earlier Muse optical instrument, source f21fc9f7ab93dfe56720232007668ba95fc541d6071454a7ba12289c5a519df0.
provenance.humanIntervention: Maintainer supplied a creative refinement brief and reviewed returned images; no hand-edited geometry. Model redesigned the instrument and repaired a bore gap by reference. Later maintainer revision (2026-11-12): flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code, 3 part edits that separate coplanar faces; materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged, and the source is no longer byte-identical to the model's export.
provenance.reviewFidelity: GPU whole, part-relative, axial-opening and locked-motion views were delivered. Independent review found coherent geometry, bright brass highlights and smeared lens reflections. No engineering or optical-performance validation.
provenance.poster: Archival GPU poster from the source before the 2026-11-12 flush-face fix. The original receipt is retained as historicalPosterReceipt; this image is not an exact-source render of the current program.

maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). ObjectiveLens: moved down 2 mm (y 0.288 -> 0.286) so its bottom is inside BoreFloor instead of on its top plane; FinderLens: moved down 2 mm (y 0.212 -> 0.210) so it sinks into the FinderTube end instead of sitting on its end plane; VialGlass: length 0.070 -> 0.074 so each end pokes 2 mm into the brass caps instead of sharing their plane
